singapore-malaysia-family.lead: A family trip where every day has something for children and adults alike: Universal Studios, the zoo, a water park and the Supertrees, then a night in Kuala Lumpur.

reasons.t: Rides, a zoo and a waterpark
reasons.d: A full day at Universal Studios Singapore, the Singapore Zoo’s open rainforest habitats, and Adventure Cove Waterpark with wave pools, snorkelling lagoons, lazy rivers and slides.
Gardens by the Bay’s illuminated Supertree Grove, and Jewel Changi Airport’s indoor waterfall and canopy forest, which delight every age.
A Kuala Lumpur extension with a night at Traders Hotel looking straight at the Petronas Twin Towers, after beach days on Sentosa.

singapore-solo-escape.lead: Singapore at your own pace: rainforest zoos, island-hopping by private boat, a dinner in a cable car and a Japanese-style onsen day.

reasons.d: Gardens by the Bay’s Cloud Forest and the Supertree Grove at night, then the Singapore Zoo, River Wonders, Bird Paradise and the Night Safari.
A multi-course dinner inside a moving cable car gondola, and a Royal Albatross luxury sunset cruise with the skyline across the water.
A private boat to the Southern Islands of Lazarus, St John’s and Kusu, and a wellness day at Joya Onsen with Japanese-style baths and Zen gardens.

thailand-andaman-luxury-escape.lead: Phuket’s jungle sanctuary and Krabi’s Ritz-Carlton Reserve, joined by a private speedboat and a sunrise balloon over Phang Nga Bay.

reasons.d: A sunrise hot air balloon over Phang Nga Bay, with thousands of vertical limestone karsts rising from the morning mist.
A private historian tour of Phuket Old Town’s Sino-Portuguese mansions, a private kayak through the mangrove canyons of Ao Thalane, and a longtail to Freedom Beach with a hot breakfast on the sand.
Dinso Resort & Villas, a Wabi-Sabi jungle sanctuary with a private pool villa, then Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, with a four-island tour and Railay’s cliffs.

thailand-cross-border-adrenaline-expedit.lead: Thailand and the Philippines in one trip: Phuket’s heritage, then Cebu’s sardine run, canyoneering and whale sharks, ending in Bangkok.

reasons.d: A private Old Town tour, a cliff-ridge cocktail at Promthep Cape, and a private speedboat to Krabi’s islands with a champagne brunch at Phra Nang Cave Beach.
Moalboal’s Sardine Run, with millions of sardines and wild sea turtles, Kawasan Falls canyoneering through a turquoise gorge with rock slides and cliff jumps, and whale sharks at Oslob.
A spa day and a southern Thai cooking masterclass in Phuket, and a finish at the JW Marriott Bangkok.

thailand-cultural-coast-royal-escapes.lead: Thailand’s royal and cultural side: Amanpuri’s Ayutthaya-style architecture, a temple to yourself and a 100-foot superyacht to Krabi.

reasons.d: An architectural masterpiece mirroring the royal Ayutthaya style on a private peninsula.
An exclusive after-hours tour of Wat Chalong, a private historian walk through Phuket Old Town, and vintage wine at sunset on Signal Ridge as the temple spires turn gold.

A private dawn helicopter loop over sea temples and coastal fortresses with a champagne brunch in a royal estate, then a private 100-foot superyacht across Phang Nga Bay to Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve.

thailand-gulf-eco-expedition.lead: The Gulf of Thailand by yacht, catamaran and helicopter: Ang Thong’s 42 islands, a sandbar that appears only at low tide and Koh Phangan’s jungle spa.

reasons.d: A private catamaran through Ang Thong National Marine Park, and a hike to its emerald-green saltwater Blue Lagoon.
A sunrise helicopter breakfast on an isolated sandbar that emerges only at low tide, and a doors-off flight over barrier reefs and tiny jungle islets.
A private 60-foot sailing yacht sunset cruise with champagne, a pool villa at Four Seasons Koh Samui, and a jungle spa at Anantara Rasananda on Koh Phangan.

thailand-ultimate-islands-jungles-luxury.lead: From Bangkok’s skyline to Koh Chang, Koh Kood, Koh Tao, Khao Sok and the Andaman coast: a long island-and-jungle journey across Thailand.

reasons.d: The glass platform of the Mahanakhon SkyWalk, Dinner in the Sky above the glittering city, and the mirrored-mosaic White Temple in Chiang Rai.
Koh Chang’s hidden beaches and jungle waterfalls, floating breakfasts and flower baths on Koh Kood, and a boat tour of Koh Tao’s coral reefs, cliffs and hidden lagoons.
A stay at Jungle House Resort in Khao Sok before the beaches of Krabi and Phuket.

vietnam-central-south-coastal-escape.lead: Vietnam’s coast, from Da Nang’s Golden Bridge to Hoi An’s lanterns, Quy Nhon’s quiet beaches, Saigon’s rooftops and Phu Quoc.

reasons.t: The Golden Bridge and Hoi An
reasons.d: The Golden Bridge at Ba Na Hills, held aloft by giant stone hands, and Hoi An Ancient Town by coconut basket boat, with lantern workshops and riverside cafés.
Quy Nhon’s untouched beaches, cliffs and fishing villages, and Mui Ne’s red and white sand dunes explored by jeep at sunrise.

reasons.t: Saigon, the Mekong and Phu Quoc
reasons.d: Rooftop bars and French colonial boulevards in Ho Chi Minh City, the Mekong Delta’s floating markets, then Phu Quoc’s beach clubs, island hopping and cable car.

vietnam-grand-expedition.lead: The whole of Vietnam, north to south: a sleeper train to Sapa, the Ha Giang Loop, Ha Long Bay and a finish on Phu Quoc.

reasons.d: Private cabins and onboard dining on the overnight train from Hanoi to Sapa, then the rice terraces and Hmong and Dao villages of Muong Hoa Valley from Topas Ecolodge.
The Ha Giang Loop and Ma Pi Leng Pass above deep gorges, and Ban Gioc Waterfalls in Cao Bang, reached by bamboo raft across the border river.
An overnight cruise through Ha Long Bay’s 1,969 limestone islands, Paradise Cave’s kilometres of chambers in Quang Binh, then Hoi An, Mui Ne and Phu Quoc.

vietnam-northern-central-discovery.lead: Northern Vietnam’s mountains, waterfalls and karsts, then the Golden Bridge and Hoi An.

reasons.d: The Ha Giang Loop past the Dong Van Karst Plateau, and Ban Gioc Waterfalls, among the largest in Asia, approached by traditional bamboo raft.

reasons.t: Ha Long Bay, on land and sea
reasons.d: A luxury sampan through the UNESCO-listed Trang An landscape of Ninh Binh, often called Ha Long Bay on land, then an overnight Indochine cruise with kayaking and sunset cocktails.
Two nights in Hanoi’s Old Quarter and the Temple of Literature, the Golden Bridge by cable car above the mountains, and a stay at Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa.
